description: Only features whose calibrated decisions pass the held-out release gate may be required by style analysis.

rhythm_grammar.four_on_floor.benchmark: Groove MIDI Dataset v1.0.0 audio-to-ADTOF events with annotated beat/downbeat grid
rhythm_grammar.four_on_floor.failure_reason: kick transcription errors leave precision and F1 below the 0.80 release gate
restrictions: reference is an explicit four-kick metrical rule, not a genre label
annotated beat/downbeat grid isolates the drum-event-to-rule chain

rhythm_grammar.four_floor_stability.benchmark: Groove MIDI Dataset v1.0.0 audio-to-ADTOF events with annotated beat/downbeat grid
rhythm_grammar.four_floor_stability.failure_reason: only two positive held-out examples and neither survives the full audio chain

rhythm_grammar.timing_quantization.benchmark: Groove MIDI Dataset v1.0.0 audio-to-ADTOF events with annotated beat/downbeat grid
rhythm_grammar.timing_quantization.failure_reason: transcription timing error is too large to preserve the annotated sixteenth-grid decision

rhythm_grammar.breakbeat.style_release_reason: requires independent human annotation of breakbeat semantics

rhythm_grammar.tamborzao.style_release_reason: exact-MIDI rule agreement does not validate named Tamborzao semantics

rhythm_grammar.tresillo.style_release_reason: reference rule is positive on 58/70 GMD test tracks and is not style-selective

rhythm_grammar.two_step.style_release_reason: requires independent human annotation of two-step groove semantics

vocal_delivery.vocal_density.style_release_reason: validated continuous evidence may contribute to scoring but is not a mandatory genre identity condition

calibration.dataset: Jamendo Corpus for Singing Voice Detection
calibration.split: none; the per-track RMS gate is deterministic and was not tuned on Jamendo
calibration.method: Demucs htdemucs vocal stem plus production v5 adaptive RMS gate
calibration.density_definition: active RMS frames divided by all RMS frames

held_out_metrics.dataset: Jamendo Corpus for Singing Voice Detection

restrictions: sing and spoken voice share one positive class
vocal density does not distinguish singing, rap delivery, or vocal chops

vocal_delivery.vocal_pitch_range.style_release_reason: validated as an independently measured vocal descriptor, not as a mandatory genre identity condition

calibration.split: SHA256 song-group-disjoint calibration split, 570 clips from 61 songs
calibration.method: MIR-1K vocal/accompaniment channels mixed to full audio, Demucs htdemucs vocal separation, pYIN with a calibration-selected 0.10 voiced-probability floor
calibration.definition: 90th minus 10th percentile of reliable voiced MIDI pitches; a broad range is at least 6 semitones

held_out_metrics.split: untuned SHA256 song-group-disjoint heldout subset passed through the full mixture-to-Demucs chain

secondary_held_out_metrics.split: all remaining untuned isolated-vocal heldout clips

restrictions: MIR-1K contains amateur Chinese pop performances and does not establish equal accuracy for rap or speech
the range is robust percentile span rather than a singer's physiological ambitus

vocal_delivery.pitch_sustain_ratio.style_release_reason: validated as continuous articulation evidence only

calibration.split: SHA256 song-group-disjoint calibration split, 570 clips from 61 songs
calibration.method: full mixture to Demucs htdemucs vocal stem, then contiguous pYIN voiced runs
calibration.definition: voiced frames belonging to runs of at least 250 ms divided by all reliable voiced frames; only internal active gaps up to 60 ms are bridged

held_out_metrics.split: untuned SHA256 song-group-disjoint heldout subset passed through the full mixture-to-Demucs chain

secondary_held_out_metrics.split: all remaining untuned isolated-vocal heldout clips

restrictions: this measures continuity of detected pitched voicing, not note articulation or lyrical phrasing
it is not validated for rap, speech, growls, or heavily processed vocal chops

vocal_delivery.melodic_contour.style_release_reason: validated as a fixed melodic-shape measurement; it is not a singing-versus-rap classifier

calibration.split: SHA256 song-group-disjoint calibration split, 570 clips from 61 songs
calibration.method: fixed 0.62 range plus 0.38 contiguous 100 ms pitch-motion score, calibrated before heldout evaluation
calibration.definition: 0.62 * min(p90-p10 range / 12 semitones, 1) + 0.38 * min(median contiguous 100 ms motion / 2.5 semitones, 1)

held_out_metrics.split: untuned SHA256 song-group-disjoint heldout subset passed through the full mixture-to-Demucs chain

secondary_held_out_metrics.split: all remaining untuned isolated-vocal heldout clips

restrictions: the separate high-motion decision is not released because the full-chain heldout subset contains no positive examples
this score must not be renamed singing probability or used to infer rap delivery

harmony.chord_change_activity.style_release_reason: change activity may contribute continuously; full-mix validation and exact chord labels remain below release scope

calibration.method: 0.85 multiplicative correction for CNN+CRF change over-segmentation

restrictions: major/minor chord labels remain below 0.80 and are not released
exact boundary precision remains below 0.80 and is not released as a separate feature
full commercial-mix domain validation remains pending

low_frequency.808_timbre_candidate.benchmark: Open Drums TR-808 vs TR-909/TR-707 bass-drum samples
low_frequency.808_timbre_candidate.failure_reason: 35-95 Hz tonal body and decay descriptors detect broad electronic kicks, not TR-808 identity
restrictions: positive samples are 25 parameter settings from one original TR-808 recording set
result is sufficient to reject the current identity claim but insufficient to train a general replacement

low_frequency.bass_syncopation.benchmark: BabySlakh 16k held-out Bass stems, source MIDI, four-bar windows
low_frequency.bass_syncopation.failure_reason: Basic Pitch note errors create too many false-positive syncopated windows; precision is below 0.80

low_frequency.bass_staccato_ratio.benchmark: BabySlakh 16k held-out Bass stems, source MIDI, four-bar windows
low_frequency.bass_staccato_ratio.failure_reason: transcribed note-off durations do not preserve the annotated staccato articulation boundary

low_frequency.bass_riff_repetition.benchmark: BabySlakh 16k held-out Bass stems, source MIDI, four-bar windows
low_frequency.bass_riff_repetition.failure_reason: missed and extra notes destabilize ordered bar-pattern recurrence

percussion_timbre.full_snare.benchmark: Groove MIDI Dataset v1.0.0 isolated exact-onset hits
percussion_timbre.full_snare.failure_reason: fixed spectral rule does not distinguish TD-11 full snare from side-stick

percussion_timbre.short_rim_snap.benchmark: Groove MIDI Dataset v1.0.0 isolated exact-onset hits
percussion_timbre.short_rim_snap.failure_reason: fixed spectral rule has zero held-out side-stick recall

percussion_timbre.short_metallic.benchmark: Groove MIDI Dataset v1.0.0 isolated exact-onset hits
percussion_timbre.short_metallic.failure_reason: fixed spectral rule does not recover closed-hat articulations

percussion_timbre.sustained_metallic.benchmark: Groove MIDI Dataset v1.0.0 isolated exact-onset hits
percussion_timbre.sustained_metallic.failure_reason: fixed decay rule confuses open/ride/cymbal hits with closed hats
